entities.summary: Kenshiro Teraji , also known as Ken Shiro , is a Japanese professional boxer. He has held world titles in two weight divisions including the World Boxing Council (WBC) light flyweight title from 2017 to 2021, the unified World Boxing Association (WBA), WBC, and Ring magazine light flyweight titles from 2022 to 2024, and the unified WBA and WBC flyweight titles in 2025.
